data.title: South Agro Trading - UK
data.subtitle: Hydroponic Produce Company
data.description: A modern showcase website for a premium hydroponic produce company specializing in sustainable leafy greens, baby leaf mixes, and microgreens grown in solar-powered greenhouses.
data.full_description: South Agro Trading Ltd operates a state-of-the-art hydroponic greenhouse facility in Fayoum, producing 11 varieties of premium leafy greens and microgreens. The website showcases their seed-to-shelf process, sustainability commitment with 95% water recirculation and 100% solar power, and their same-day delivery model for the freshest produce.
